author: TitanHaze
body: A day ago I've been ban on one of my favorite server which is this. I was playing some other game but the lag was unbearable. I decided to go play some old time Minecraft. Minecraft usually don't lag so that was the only game I could've played. I was in Nebula getting some lag. It was really irritating. Every time i died i had to restart my Minecraft. One time i had a big lag spike. After the lag spike people on chat was like "LOL TITANHAZE, HACKS ETC..." I was like what? Several minutes later it said "banned for flying" I got really upset. I would love to get unbanned because this is in my top charts and has my favorite game mode Nebula Wars. I've been playing this with my friends and would love to take my time and play on the server again. This is also my first time sending an appeal. Its been over 24 hours and i feel like I'm missing out on something so great. Thank you so much for reading my ban appeal. Have a great time and good luck.
